description: BASE-DESIGN.md §7: keeps this pinned-everything scaffold from going stale. Digests are pinned (pinDigests) so base-image security patches arrive only via a Renovate PR rather than silently on rebuild — that trade-off is acceptable only because Renovate is actually running here. A project that disables Renovate should drop the digest pins rather than sit on a frozen base image indefinitely.

packageRules.description: Group patch/minor/digest/pin updates into one weekly PR. Majors are deliberately excluded so each gets its own PR and gets read.
